The '''''α-foreman''''' was the chief foreman at the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] construction docks. Answering only to the head of KDY, there was only one α-foreman and hundreds of [[β-supervisor]]s. The loyalty of the α-foreman, as well as all KDY employees, went unquestioned by [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
